example.title: Route No. 1-Overton-Lake Mead Road, Culverts and Headwalls
example.place: 6 miles south of Overton, Clark County, NV

brief: Park-road culverts of the 1930s: corrugated steel pipes about 3 ft in diameter with hand-laid masonry headwalls of flat red and brown sandstone slabs in three styles, straight headwalls, 'special' headwalls with stepped ends, and winged headwalls with splayed wing walls and a stone apron, each set at the toe of a gravel fill under a two-lane highway. Arid wash setting. For the Bellhaven highway, use the winged headwall type in local grey fieldstone.

traits.material: corrugated steel pipe, dry-laid/mortared sandstone headwalls
